page: City page: B2B lead generation Chennai (/b2b-lead-generation-chennai)

items.question: Do we need to be physically based in Chennai to work with you?
items.answer: No. Myntmore runs every engagement remotely from our office in BKC, Mumbai, so your team does not need to be in Chennai. Strategy calls, sequence approvals and weekly reporting all happen over video calls and a shared dashboard, the same way they do for clients in every other city.

items.question: Do you only work with Chennai or Tamil Nadu businesses?
items.answer: No. Chennai is one of several Indian markets we actively serve alongside clients across India and internationally. If your buyers are in Chennai, or you are a Chennai company selling elsewhere in India or overseas, we can build the outbound motion for either direction.

items.question: How long before we start seeing meetings booked?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: Which Chennai industries do you have the most experience with?
items.answer: Automotive and auto-component manufacturing, healthcare and hospital-services companies, and IT/ITES businesses along the OMR corridor are where we have the deepest playbooks. Examples include 2.1x more positive replies for an engineering goods exporter and 140 qualified leads for a medical tourism platform. The same ICP-first approach adapts to most B2B sectors.

items.question: What channels do you actually use to generate leads?
items.answer: Primarily cold email and LinkedIn outreach, layered with account-based marketing for named target accounts, with AI-assisted list building and personalisation underneath all three. For Chennai manufacturers selling abroad, that usually means email to overseas procurement teams and LinkedIn for senior buyers. We pick the mix based on where your buyers spend their attention.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an in-house SDR in Chennai means months of recruiting and ramp-up before they are fully productive, and even then, one person can only run so many sequences at once. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the fully loaded cost of a hire, and scales without you managing headcount.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.
